# Topophilia Design Studio

> Luxury interior design and wardrobe styling studio based in Santa Rosa, serving Healdsburg, Sonoma and all of Sonoma County plus the greater Bay Area (Napa, Marin, San Francisco). All work is custom quoted and built around the client's budget. The studio sources high-quality, one-of-a-kind furniture, clothing and accessories from abroad and at home. "Topophilia" means a love of place.

## Services
- [The Collector](https://www.topophiliadesign.com/the-collector): sourcing and finding unique items for your space
- [The Tailor](https://www.topophiliadesign.com/the-tailor): making each piece work with what you have
- [The Builder](https://www.topophiliadesign.com/the-builder): building a cohesive plan
